2120959336633499648.en_summary: Perhaps Nvidia’s board isn’t operating independently of political pressure, intelligence interests, regulators and powerful institutional shareholders. A board appointing someone doesn’t establish innocence, especially when that same board expressed confidence in Huang before his departure. Kress oversaw financial reporting when Singapore accounted for 22% of revenue before a methodology change removed it as a separate category. That alone warrants independent scrutiny. Who influenced Nvidia’s succession decision, when was Colette Kress identified as Huang’s replacement, and should the very people claiming to restore accountability now be subjected to independent investigation themselves?
2120959336633499648.zh_summary: 也許 Nvidia 的董事會並非獨立於政治壓力、情報利益、監管機構和強大的機構股東運作。董事會任命某人並不能確立無辜，尤其是同一董事會在 Huang 離任前曾表示對他有信心。Kress 負責財務報告時，新加坡佔收入的 22%，在方法變更前將其作為單獨類別移除。這本身就值得獨立審查。誰影響了 Nvidia 的繼任決定，Colette Kress 何時被確定為 Huang 的接替者，以及那些聲稱恢復問責的人本身是否應接受獨立調查？

ticker_notes.NVDA: 董事會可能受政治和監管影響，新加坡收入曾佔 22%，繼任過程存疑
